question: What are polymers or macromolecules?
urdu_translation: polymers یا macromolecules کیا ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Small ions formed by dissolving salts / small ions جو salts dissolve کرنے سے بنتے ہیں
B: Extremely large molecules formed by linking many simple molecular units / انتہائی بڑے molecules جو بہت سے simple molecular units کو link کرنے سے بنتے ہیں
C: Mixtures of unrelated gases / unrelated gases کے mixtures
D: Single atoms with no chemical bonds / single atoms جن میں chemical bonds نہ ہوں
correct_answer: B | Extremely large molecules formed by linking many simple molecular units / انتہائی بڑے molecules جو بہت سے simple molecular units کو link کرنے سے بنتے ہیں

A: Catalysts / catalysts
B: Monomers / monomers

B: Distillation / distillation

correct_answer: D | Polymerization / polymerization

topic: 26.0 Introduction, Types and Importance of Polymers

topic: 26.0 Introduction, Types and Importance of Polymers
question: Why are polymers important in daily life?
urdu_translation: polymers daily life میں important کیوں ہیں؟
A: They can have high strength, flexibility and resistance to heat and chemicals / ان میں high strength، flexibility اور heat و chemicals کے خلاف resistance ہو سکتی ہے
B: They are always brittle and chemically weak / وہ ہمیشہ brittle اور chemically weak ہوتے ہیں

D: They exist only as gases / وہ صرف gases کی صورت میں ہوتے ہیں
correct_answer: A | They can have high strength, flexibility and resistance to heat and chemicals / ان میں high strength، flexibility اور heat و chemicals کے خلاف resistance ہو سکتی ہے

topic: 26.0 Introduction, Types and Importance of Polymers
question: Which development described in the chapter shows the growing importance of synthetic polymers?
urdu_translation: chapter میں کون سی development synthetic polymers کی بڑھتی importance کو show کرتی ہے؟
A: The complete replacement of polymers by metals / polymers کا metals سے complete replacement

C: The elimination of all plastics from daily life / daily life سے تمام plastics کا elimination
D: The conversion of natural fibres into gases / natural fibres کا gases میں conversion
correct_answer: B | The gradual replacement of metals, wood and cotton by man-made synthetic polymers / metals، wood اور cotton کا man-made synthetic polymers سے gradual replacement

question: What type of bond is present in monomers used for addition polymerization?
urdu_translation: addition polymerization میں used monomers میں کون سا bond موجود ہوتا ہے؟
A: Only ionic bonds / صرف ionic bonds
B: Only ester linkages / صرف ester linkages
C: A double or triple bond / double یا triple bond
D: Only amide linkages / صرف amide linkages
correct_answer: C | A double or triple bond / double یا triple bond

question: Which polymer is formed from ethene?
urdu_translation: ethene سے کون سا polymer بنتا ہے؟
A: Polyamide / polyamide
B: Polyester / polyester
C: Polyethene or polythene / polyethene یا polythene
D: Bakelite / bakelite
correct_answer: C | Polyethene or polythene / polyethene یا polythene

question: What happens to the C=C double bond of ethene during addition polymerization?
urdu_translation: addition polymerization کے دوران ethene کے C=C double bond کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: It changes into an ester linkage / یہ ester linkage میں change ہوتا ہے
B: It breaks to allow ethene molecules to join / یہ break ہوتا ہے تاکہ ethene molecules join کر سکیں
C: It changes into an amide linkage / یہ amide linkage میں change ہوتا ہے
D: It remains unchanged in the polymer chain / polymer chain میں unchanged رہتا ہے
correct_answer: B | It breaks to allow ethene molecules to join / یہ break ہوتا ہے تاکہ ethene molecules join کر سکیں

question: Which conditions are usually used for addition polymerization according to the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter کے مطابق addition polymerization کے لیے عموماً کون سے conditions use ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Low pressure without a catalyst / low pressure بغیر catalyst
B: High pressure and a catalyst / high pressure اور catalyst
C: Only sunlight and water / صرف sunlight اور water
D: An acid-base titration / acid-base titration
correct_answer: B | High pressure and a catalyst / high pressure اور catalyst

question: What is produced besides the polymer in addition polymerization?
urdu_translation: addition polymerization میں polymer کے علاوہ کیا produce ہوتا ہے؟
A: A water molecule is always formed / water molecule ہمیشہ form ہوتا ہے
B: Hydrogen chloride is always formed / hydrogen chloride ہمیشہ form ہوتا ہے
C: Ammonia is always formed / ammonia ہمیشہ form ہوتی ہے
D: No by-product is formed / کوئی by-product form نہیں ہوتا
correct_answer: D | No by-product is formed / کوئی by-product form نہیں ہوتا

question: Which equation represents addition polymerization of ethene?
urdu_translation: کون سی equation ethene کی addition polymerization کو represent کرتی ہے؟
A: nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ / nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ
B: nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CO−NH−]ₙ + H₂O / nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CO−NH−]ₙ + H₂O
C: CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH / CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH
D: CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O / CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O
correct_answer: A | nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ / nCH₂=CH₂ → [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ

question: Why does an addition polymer contain single bonds along its polymer backbone?
urdu_translation: addition polymer کی backbone میں single bonds کیوں ہوتے ہیں؟
A: The polymer is formed by esterification / polymer esterification سے بنتا ہے
B: A water molecule joins every monomer / water molecule ہر monomer کے ساتھ join ہوتا ہے
C: The multiple bond in each monomer opens when the monomers link together / monomers link ہونے پر ہر monomer کا multiple bond open ہو جاتا ہے
D: The monomers contain only ionic bonds / monomers میں صرف ionic bonds ہوتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | The multiple bond in each monomer opens when the monomers link together / monomers link ہونے پر ہر monomer کا multiple bond open ہو جاتا ہے

question: What is the role of a catalyst in addition polymerization?
urdu_translation: addition polymerization میں catalyst کا role کیا ہے؟
A: It becomes the repeating unit of the polymer / یہ polymer کا repeating unit بن جاتا ہے
B: It is eliminated as water / یہ water کی صورت میں eliminate ہوتا ہے
C: It changes the polymer into a natural polymer / یہ polymer کو natural polymer میں change کرتا ہے
D: It helps the polymerization reaction proceed under the required conditions / یہ required conditions میں polymerization reaction کو proceed کرنے میں help کرتا ہے
correct_answer: D | It helps the polymerization reaction proceed under the required conditions / یہ required conditions میں polymerization reaction کو proceed کرنے میں help کرتا ہے

question: How many different monomer types usually react in condensation polymerization?
urdu_translation: condensation polymerization میں عموماً کتنی different monomer types react کرتی ہیں؟
A: One only / صرف one
B: Three in every case / ہر case میں three
C: No monomer is used / کوئی monomer use نہیں ہوتا
D: Two / two
correct_answer: D | Two / two

question: Which small molecules may be eliminated during condensation polymerization?
urdu_translation: condensation polymerization کے دوران کون سے small molecules eliminate ہو سکتے ہیں؟
A: H₂O, HCl or NH₃ / H₂O، HCl یا NH₃
B: Only O₂ / صرف O₂
C: Only N₂ / صرف N₂
D: Only CO₂ / صرف CO₂
correct_answer: A | H₂O, HCl or NH₃ / H₂O، HCl یا NH₃

question: Which two monomers form PET in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں PET کون سے two monomers سے بنتا ہے؟
A: Ethene and hydrogen / ethene اور hydrogen
B: Butanedioic acid and butane-1,4-diamine / butanedioic acid اور butane-1,4-diamine
C: Ethane diol and terephthalic acid / ethane diol اور terephthalic acid
D: Propene and styrene / propene اور styrene
correct_answer: C | Ethane diol and terephthalic acid / ethane diol اور terephthalic acid

question: Which functional groups react to form the ester linkage in PET?
urdu_translation: PET میں ester linkage بنانے کے لیے کون سے functional groups react کرتے ہیں؟
A: Amino and amino groups / amino اور amino groups
B: Double bonds only / صرف double bonds
C: Carboxyl and hydroxyl groups / carboxyl اور hydroxyl groups
D: Amide and ester groups / amide اور ester groups
correct_answer: C | Carboxyl and hydroxyl groups / carboxyl اور hydroxyl groups

question: Why can the PET polymerization process continue at both ends of the growing molecule?
urdu_translation: PET polymerization process growing molecule کے دونوں ends پر کیوں continue کر سکتا ہے؟
A: The molecule has no functional groups / molecule میں functional groups نہیں ہوتے
B: Reactive functional groups remain at both ends / reactive functional groups دونوں ends پر remain کرتے ہیں
C: The ester linkages become ionic / ester linkages ionic بن جاتی ہیں
D: The catalyst becomes a monomer / catalyst monomer بن جاتا ہے
correct_answer: B | Reactive functional groups remain at both ends / reactive functional groups دونوں ends پر remain کرتے ہیں

question: Which linkage is present in PET?
urdu_translation: PET میں کون سی linkage present ہوتی ہے؟
A: Ester linkage, −COO− / ester linkage، −COO−
B: Amide linkage, −CONH− / amide linkage، −CONH−
C: Carbon-carbon double bond / carbon-carbon double bond
D: Ionic sodium-chloride linkage / ionic sodium-chloride linkage
correct_answer: A | Ester linkage, −COO− / ester linkage، −COO−

question: Which structural group represents an ester linkage?
urdu_translation: کون سا structural group ester linkage کو represent کرتا ہے؟
A: R−C(=O)−NH−R / R−C(=O)−NH−R
B: R−C(=O)−R / R−C(=O)−R
C: R−CH₂−CH₂−R / R−CH₂−CH₂−R
D: R−C(=O)−O−R / R−C(=O)−O−R
correct_answer: D | R−C(=O)−O−R / R−C(=O)−O−R

question: Why is PET classified as a condensation polymer?
urdu_translation: PET کو condensation polymer کیوں classify کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Ethene monomers add without eliminating any molecule / ethene monomers کسی molecule کو eliminate کیے بغیر add ہوتے ہیں
B: It is formed only by breaking a carbon-carbon double bond / یہ صرف carbon-carbon double bond break ہونے سے بنتا ہے
C: It contains no repeating units / اس میں repeating units نہیں ہوتے
D: Two bifunctional monomers react and a small molecule is eliminated while ester linkages form / two bifunctional monomers react کرتے ہیں اور ester linkages بنتے وقت small molecule eliminate ہوتا ہے
correct_answer: D | Two bifunctional monomers react and a small molecule is eliminated while ester linkages form / two bifunctional monomers react کرتے ہیں اور ester linkages بنتے وقت small molecule eliminate ہوتا ہے

question: How can PET be chemically recycled according to the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter کے مطابق PET کو chemically recycle کیسے کیا جا سکتا ہے؟
A: It can only be burned in open air / اسے صرف open air میں burn کیا جا سکتا ہے
B: It is converted permanently into metal / اسے permanently metal میں convert کیا جاتا ہے
C: It can be broken down into monomers and polymerized again / اسے monomers میں break down کر کے دوبارہ polymerize کیا جا سکتا ہے
D: It cannot be recycled in any way / اسے کسی way سے recycle نہیں کیا جا سکتا
correct_answer: C | It can be broken down into monomers and polymerized again / اسے monomers میں break down کر کے دوبارہ polymerize کیا جا سکتا ہے

question: Which two monomers form the polyamide described in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں described polyamide کون سے two monomers سے بنتا ہے؟
A: Ethane diol and terephthalic acid / ethane diol اور terephthalic acid
B: Butanedioic acid and butane-1,4-diamine / butanedioic acid اور butane-1,4-diamine
C: Ethene and propene / ethene اور propene
D: Styrene and water / styrene اور water
correct_answer: B | Butanedioic acid and butane-1,4-diamine / butanedioic acid اور butane-1,4-diamine

question: Which linkage is present in a polyamide?
urdu_translation: polyamide میں کون سی linkage present ہوتی ہے؟
A: Amide linkage, −CONH− / amide linkage، −CONH−
B: Ester linkage, −COO− / ester linkage، −COO−
C: Carbon-carbon double bond / carbon-carbon double bond
D: Ether linkage only / صرف ether linkage
correct_answer: A | Amide linkage, −CONH− / amide linkage، −CONH−

question: Which polymer has an amide linkage?
urdu_translation: کون سا polymer amide linkage رکھتا ہے؟
A: Polyamide / polyamide
B: Polyethene / polyethene
C: Polystyrene / polystyrene
D: Polyester / polyester
correct_answer: A | Polyamide / polyamide

question: Which functional groups react to form an amide linkage?
urdu_translation: amide linkage بنانے کے لیے کون سے functional groups react کرتے ہیں؟
A: Hydroxyl and hydroxyl groups / hydroxyl اور hydroxyl groups
B: Two carbon-carbon double bonds / two carbon-carbon double bonds
C: Ester and ketone groups / ester اور ketone groups
D: Carboxyl and amino groups / carboxyl اور amino groups
correct_answer: D | Carboxyl and amino groups / carboxyl اور amino groups

question: What small molecule is lost when the described polyamide forms?
urdu_translation: described polyamide form ہونے پر کون سا small molecule lost ہوتا ہے؟
A: Water / water
B: Oxygen / oxygen
C: Nitrogen / nitrogen
D: Methane / methane
correct_answer: A | Water / water

question: Which set contains only condensation polymers listed in the chapter?
urdu_translation: کون سا set chapter میں listed صرف condensation polymers پر مشتمل ہے؟
A: Polyethene, polystyrene and PVC / polyethene، polystyrene اور PVC
B: Polyethene, nylon and PVC / polyethene، nylon اور PVC
C: Polystyrene, polyester and polyethene / polystyrene، polyester اور polyethene
D: Polyester, nylon and bakelite / polyester، nylon اور bakelite
correct_answer: D | Polyester, nylon and bakelite / polyester، nylon اور bakelite

question: Which statement correctly compares addition and condensation polymerization?
urdu_translation: کون سا statement addition اور condensation polymerization کو correctly compare کرتا ہے؟
A: Both always eliminate water / دونوں ہمیشہ water eliminate کرتی ہیں
B: Addition always uses two different monomers / addition ہمیشہ two different monomers use کرتی ہے
C: Condensation requires a carbon-carbon double bond in one monomer only / condensation میں صرف one monomer کا carbon-carbon double bond required ہوتا ہے
D: Addition uses an unsaturated monomer without a by-product, while condensation uses bifunctional monomers and eliminates a small molecule / addition unsaturated monomer کو without by-product use کرتی ہے جبکہ condensation bifunctional monomers use کر کے small molecule eliminate کرتی ہے
correct_answer: D | Addition uses an unsaturated monomer without a by-product, while condensation uses bifunctional monomers and eliminates a small molecule / addition unsaturated monomer کو without by-product use کرتی ہے جبکہ condensation bifunctional monomers use کر کے small molecule eliminate کرتی ہے

question: Which feature of the polymer chain most directly indicates condensation polymerization?
urdu_translation: polymer chain کی کون سی feature condensation polymerization کو most directly indicate کرتی ہے؟
A: A specific linkage such as an ester or amide linkage / specific linkage جیسے ester یا amide linkage
B: Only carbon-carbon single bonds with no functional linkage / صرف carbon-carbon single bonds اور no functional linkage
C: A free monomer double bond remaining in every repeat unit / ہر repeat unit میں free monomer double bond
D: Absence of all heteroatoms / تمام heteroatoms کی absence
correct_answer: A | A specific linkage such as an ester or amide linkage / specific linkage جیسے ester یا amide linkage

question: What is a repeating unit?
urdu_translation: repeating unit کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: The catalyst used once in polymerization / catalyst جو polymerization میں once use ہوتا ہے
B: The small molecule eliminated from every addition polymer / small molecule جو ہر addition polymer سے eliminate ہوتا ہے
C: The structural section that repeats along a polymer chain / structural section جو polymer chain کے along repeat ہوتا ہے
D: A separate impurity trapped in plastic / separate impurity جو plastic میں trapped ہو
correct_answer: C | The structural section that repeats along a polymer chain / structural section جو polymer chain کے along repeat ہوتا ہے

question: What does the subscript n in a polymer formula indicate?
urdu_translation: polymer formula میں subscript n کیا indicate کرتا ہے؟
A: The number of catalysts / catalysts کی number
B: The charge on the polymer / polymer پر charge
C: A large number of repeating units / repeating units کی large number
D: The number of by-products / by-products کی number
correct_answer: C | A large number of repeating units / repeating units کی large number

question: Which monomer is obtained from the repeat unit [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ?
urdu_translation: repeat unit [−CH₂−CH₂−]ₙ سے کون سا monomer حاصل ہوتا ہے؟
A: CH₃−CH₃ / CH₃−CH₃
B: CH₂=CH₂ / CH₂=CH₂
C: CH≡CH / CH≡CH
D: CH₃CH₂OH / CH₃CH₂OH
correct_answer: B | CH₂=CH₂ / CH₂=CH₂

question: What is done to the bond between the two carbon atoms when deducing an addition monomer from its polymer?
urdu_translation: polymer سے addition monomer deduce کرتے وقت two carbon atoms کے bond کے ساتھ کیا کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: The single bond is changed to a double bond / single bond کو double bond میں change کیا جاتا ہے
B: The single bond is removed completely / single bond کو completely remove کیا جاتا ہے
C: The single bond is changed to an ester linkage / single bond کو ester linkage میں change کیا جاتا ہے
D: The single bond is changed to an ionic bond / single bond کو ionic bond میں change کیا جاتا ہے
correct_answer: A | The single bond is changed to a double bond / single bond کو double bond میں change کیا جاتا ہے

question: Which monomer gives the polymer repeat unit [−CH₂−CH(OCOCH₃)−]ₙ?
urdu_translation: کون سا monomer polymer repeat unit [−CH₂−CH(OCOCH₃)−]ₙ دیتا ہے؟
A: CH₂=CH₂−CH₃ / CH₂=CH₂−CH₃
B: CH₂=CH−OCOCH₃ / CH₂=CH−OCOCH₃
C: CH₂=CH−COOCH₃ / CH₂=CH−COOCH₃
D: CH₃CH₂OCOCH₃ / CH₃CH₂OCOCH₃
correct_answer: B | CH₂=CH−OCOCH₃ / CH₂=CH−OCOCH₃

question: Which monomer forms polypropylene with repeat unit [−CH₂−CH(CH₃)−]ₙ?
urdu_translation: کون سا monomer repeat unit [−CH₂−CH(CH₃)−]ₙ والا polypropylene بناتا ہے؟
A: Ethene, CH₂=CH₂ / ethene، CH₂=CH₂
B: Ethane, CH₃CH₃ / ethane، CH₃CH₃
C: Propene, CH₂=CHCH₃ / propene، CH₂=CHCH₃
D: Propanol, CH₃CH₂CH₂OH / propanol، CH₃CH₂CH₂OH
correct_answer: C | Propene, CH₂=CHCH₃ / propene، CH₂=CHCH₃

question: When deducing the two monomers of a polyester, where is the repeat unit broken?
urdu_translation: polyester کے two monomers deduce کرتے وقت repeat unit کہاں break کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: At every carbon-carbon bond / ہر carbon-carbon bond پر
B: At the centre of each hydroxyl group / ہر hydroxyl group کے centre پر
C: At the catalyst-polymer bond / catalyst-polymer bond پر
D: At the bond between CO and O of the ester linkage / ester linkage میں CO اور O کے درمیان bond پر
correct_answer: D | At the bond between CO and O of the ester linkage / ester linkage میں CO اور O کے درمیان bond پر

question: Which end groups are restored when deducing monomers from a polyamide repeat unit?
urdu_translation: polyamide repeat unit سے monomers deduce کرتے وقت کون سے end groups restore کیے جاتے ہیں؟
A: OH on the dicarboxylic-acid ends and H on the diamine ends / dicarboxylic-acid ends پر OH اور diamine ends پر H
B: NH₂ on the dicarboxylic-acid ends and Cl on the diamine ends / dicarboxylic-acid ends پر NH₂ اور diamine ends پر Cl
C: Only double bonds on all ends / تمام ends پر صرف double bonds
D: No atoms are added to the ends / ends پر کوئی atoms add نہیں کیے جاتے
correct_answer: A | OH on the dicarboxylic-acid ends and H on the diamine ends / dicarboxylic-acid ends پر OH اور diamine ends پر H

question: Which polymers are produced from ethylene, propylene and styrene respectively?
urdu_translation: ethylene، propylene اور styrene سے respectively کون سے polymers produce ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Polyamide, polyester and nylon / polyamide، polyester اور nylon
B: PET, bakelite and rayon / PET، bakelite اور rayon
C: Starch, cellulose and protein / starch، cellulose اور protein
D: Polyethylene, polypropylene and polystyrene / polyethylene، polypropylene اور polystyrene
correct_answer: D | Polyethylene, polypropylene and polystyrene / polyethylene، polypropylene اور polystyrene

question: Which of the following is a synthetic polymer?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل میں سے کون سا synthetic polymer ہے؟
A: Polyester / polyester
B: Starch / starch
C: Cellulose / cellulose
D: Animal fat / animal fat
correct_answer: A | Polyester / polyester

question: Which property allows plastics to be formed into many desired shapes?
